# Change the package that owns the behaviour, not Express core

Express core stays minimal. Routing belongs in the router, path matching in `path-to-regexp`, final error handling in `finalhandler`: don't duplicate their logic in Express or add what Node.js already provides — propose the change in the package that owns it.

**Why:** Stated on 6 PRs by 4 reviewers.
